rebecca (People Ops): Quick Q: we're tightening up the promo evidence template. Want this thread to capture manager dos/don'ts for submissions. Deadline for feedback: Fri EOD.

sam (Eng Manager): Do: 20 examples max, 3 lines each (scenario, action, outcome). Don't: long narratives or generic praise.

jules (Manager): Add: include dates and who validated the work (peer, PM, customer). Links to PRs/dashboards preferred.

mira (IC): Can we include private Slack threads as evidence? I don't want to paste lots of convo.

rebecca (People Ops): Short excerpt + link is fine. Format: one-line context, 1-2 sentence quote, source link. Keep PII redacted.

comp-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: Promo nominations close in 3 business days: https://go.company/promo-form

sam (Eng Manager): For "stretch" work, please state whether the work is sustained (>=12 weeks) or emerging (<12 weeks) so committee knows context.

jules (Manager): If comp band is frozen, we accept title-only with a documented path and timeline. Manager should suggest a timing forecast and who owns the follow-up.

mira (IC): Equity/comp ask: what level of detail do you want from managers?

rebecca (People Ops): Include current grant date/size, suggested equity target (or range), and whether this is promotion vs retention. Recruiting/comp will do sizing.

sam (Eng Manager): Conflicting peer feedback: include a 1-paragraph reconciliation explaining discrepancies and pointing to objective artifacts. Committee trusts manager narrative + evidence.

jules (Manager): One clarification: can titles be backdated 60 days?

rebecca (People Ops): Titles can be backdated up to 30 days with manager + director approval. >30 days needs HRBP sign-off and a business justification.

mira (IC): How do we communicate the outcome? Manager tells the person first, right?

rebecca (People Ops): Yes. Manager tells person first. Company-wide announces only for senior+ bands or with manager request. Compensation details are confidential. We provide a manager script template in the toolkit.

comp-bot: :white_check_mark: Promo toolkit updated: https://go.company/promo-toolkit (updated 2026-03-15)

sam (Eng Manager): Thanks  I'll review the draft and send feedback.

rebecca (People Ops): Appreciate it. I'll incorporate and post final template by Monday morning. DM for urgent retention cases.
